claims.note: Title and description restate the headline counts: 13 replays, 13 semantically identical, 11 byte-identical, both flips at temperature 0.0. Every figure is read from run.jsonl and matches the schema partial string-for-string.

run.methodology: 13 foreground replays of one fixed /api/chat tool-calling request (stat_path; 'Check whether docs/config.md exists and get its hash. Use the tool.') on Ollama 0.20.3 with qwen3:0.6b Q4_K_M, seed 42, num_predict 80, num_ctx 4096, think=false, across four prompt shapes (single turn temp 0.0; one history turn temp 0.0; ~1,200-token repository-listing prefix (1,420 total prompt tokens) temp 0.0; single turn temp 0.7), round-robin between 2026-11-15T13:23:34Z and 13:31:29Z on a shared CPU-only host. Each call appended to run.jsonl and flushed before the next started; 0 errors. Per call the probe recorded the raw arguments, key order and sha256 over both json.dumps(args) and json.dumps(args, sort_keys=True). Counts were re-read from run.jsonl and cross-checked against flip_table.csv and normalise_selftest.txt; no rate is derived.

claims.note: Explicit refusal of the over-reading 'temperature does not matter', listing the confounds (N=3-4, confounded conditions, 3/3 at 0.7). Reasoning about the sample's limits, not a new measurement.
Three harness consequences of asserting on member order. Snapshot churn and retry accounting are described as mechanisms, not measured here; the five-point move is called out as unsupported at N=13.
Separates this page's object from two adjacent failures (no-state-guard loops, history corruption) and links the sibling articles; no measurement is claimed for those pages.
Describes the normalise-then-hash recipe before showing it; procedure, not a result.

Code listing of normalise_tool_call(). It is an abridged form of the shipped helper: the full file additionally separates the JSON-string parse failure case. Behaviour shown (sort_keys canonical form, sha256 digest, missing-argument reporting) matches the file that produced normalise_selftest.txt.

Five self-test cases (object args, reordered args, missing argument, JSON-string args, no tool call) pass, and the replay over the 13 records returns one digest. Output captured in normalise_selftest.txt at 2026-11-15T13:38:48Z.

benchmarks.note: Explicitly not a benchmark: 13 replays of one request, reported as counts with denominators, with the N=20 matrix named as not run and wall time declared uninterpretable on a shared host. No accuracy, latency, throughput or flip-rate claim.

cover.note: No cover image and no existing cover to preserve; no image generator invoked.

evidence_boundary: Local fixture measurement only: one CPU-only host, one model, one prompt fixture, 13 calls, shared with a concurrent stage workload. No vendor system was measured. No third-party source download is offered to readers: the cached vendor documentation copies were moved to research/cache/agent-tool-call-repeatability-2026/ and are neither linked nor listed as reader artifacts.
proposed_process_improvements: Supply-stage proposals for probe-based articles should carry a sample size that fits one research attempt on this host (N=3-4 per condition, ~13 calls, ~8 minutes), or be marked as needing a dedicated measurement window; the N=20 plan could not be executed in budget.

Reader-facing helpers promised in the original evidence plan (the normalise_tool_call function with its four edge cases) were not produced by the research stage; the write stage had to author and test them to keep the promise. The research stage's artifact list should include every promised helper.
